about: Retrieval regression set over the kit corpus (audit VS-14, 2026-10-11). Run by db/tests/test_retrieval.py after ingest.py + graph_build.py. Ground truth comes from the kit (amd/system1/data/kit) and the Spot User Guide, never from flag ids (incident:flag-<id> depends on the database's flag numbering). 'stretch' cases are reported but do not fail the run.
query_prefix: EMBED_QUERY_PREFIX; unset = the Qwen3 instruction (DEFAULT_QUERY_PREFIX in amd/embed/client.py, backend/app/config.py, amd/mcp/spot_mcp/config.py) + query, no space

fields.mode: hybrid = match_documents_hybrid(vec, query, kinds, match_count => k); vector = match_documents(vec, kinds, match_count => k)
fields.expect_any: at least min_hits (default 1) of these doc_ids in the top k (only 1 when expect_pred is also given)
fields.expect_pred: rows matching any/all of the conditions; 'meta.x' reads metadata->>'x'; at least min_hits of them
fields.first_must_match: the first row must satisfy expect_pred
fields.expect_top_sim_below: the best similarity in the top k is below this

documents.note: exact asset id: every hit is an HX-204 event or incident
